verdict.rationale: Shortcut ships an official first-party MCP server with setup guides for connecting agents such as Codex CLI, Claude Code and Cursor. Through those clients a user can operate their Shortcut workspace with natural-language instructions. However, natural-language operation depends on a third-party AI client, and no native in-app natural-language command interface is documented. Missing for 10: a native built-in natural-language command interface, documentation of which workspace actions are exposed through MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Setup guide for connecting Codex CLI to Shortcut through the Shortcut MCP server.
Connect Shortcut to tools like Cursor and Claude Code to get agents coding and synced to GitHub.
You can add a new MCP server from the Claude Code CLI.
Put agents to work right alongside your team.
